decision_conditions: The proposed L shaped roof extension, by reason of its excessive scale, bulk, width and limited setbacks from the ridge, eaves and neighbouring boundaries, would fail to appear as a subordinate addition to the original dwelling and would result in an incongruous and visually dominant form of development that would harm the character and appearance of the host property and the wider terrace. The Local Planning Authority does not consider that the limited number of similar roof extensions within the locality establishes an emerging character sufficient to justify the proposal, particularly as no evidence has been provided to demonstrate that those developments benefit from planning permission or have otherwise been confirmed lawful. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy 53 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan and the adopted Retrofit and Residential Alterations Supplementary Planning Document.
description: Construction of a dormer roof extension to the main rear roof, including an extension above the two storey outrigger, together with installation of two roof lights to front roof slope.
